title: Growing up in McDonoghville near George Lewis
summary: He lived on the river side below Algiers near where George Lewis later lived.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When you started on drums, did you live across the river then?
No, I lived in the city. Where was it you?
That's what I mean, over in New Orleans.

I lived in New Orleans. But I lived on the other side of the river where I was born at down on the other side of the river in Algiers in McLendonville. That's right below Algiers. Down the coast they call it. Down there where George Lewis lived. Yeah.
Well, it wasn't as far as the Cut-Off, what they call the Cut-Off.
No, I wasn't born at the Cut-Off. I was born right along, a little past where George Lewis lived. Where George Lewis lived.

You ought to see that place now. It's all grown up. Yeah. Hundreds of houses in there. Yeah. They have the new bridge now. Uh-huh. So they're developing all of that. They built up hundreds of houses, all those streets past. George was the last house there when he built it.
And now there's a hundred of them past him.

Yeah. Well, the place I was born, we was living right on the river. House built right on that side of the river, right by the, under, when the water's reds, was, uh, be all under the building. Oh, yeah. Well, I was born right there on the river side. And that'd been a long time ago. Yeah. Yeah.
